Airport Splits Its Parking Into Three Areas
The single lot at Linden Regional Airport has become three areas with separate rules and rates.
By Nolan Sedgwick, Transportation Reporter
Since June, drivers at Linden Regional Airport have parked in one of three areas instead of the single lot that served the terminal for years. Over the first two months, staff counted about a third more vehicles left overnight than in the same period last year, and most of that increase was recorded in Elmgate.
The three areas differ in how they charge. Drivers who leave a car for only a few hours can pay by the hour in Elmgate, while those who stay longer are charged by the day or, in Tilbury, by the week.
"Offering drivers a choice of distance and price has filled spaces that used to sit empty," said Yvonne Salcedo, who manages airport operations. "I accept that many regular travelers who once walked to the terminal from their cars now ride the shuttle instead, and not all of them are pleased."
A further change takes effect on October 1, when Cransley will begin holding its spaces for drivers with reservations and will no longer allow any stay to run beyond four days. Drivers who plan longer stays, or who arrive without a booking, will need to use one of the other two areas.

Office Machine Repairs at Halverton
By Trevor Nilsen, Services Correspondent
Halverton Equipment Care, which services office beverage machines across the district, now handles reported faults in one of two ways. A technician visits the client's own office, or the machine is collected and repaired at the company's service center. Either option is offered within one week.
Rachel Tomlin, the firm's service manager, said the second option was added last year because requests for same-week visits were rising faster than technicians could keep up with. "Now every client can be given a
fixed
date for the work," she said.
Both options are available under the standard care agreement, which includes servicing of up to six machines at each client address. Replaceable supplies such as water filters are billed separately.
Full terms appear in the company's printed price list.
